clips.title: The story
paras: Along the shores of Stranglethorn Vale rests an abandoned lifeboat marked with the faded words Smotts' Revenge. Piling barbecued buzzard wings and junglevine wine upon the wrecked craft serves to lure out the giant Negolash.

The wreckage of a small boat lies neglected, carrying only weathered lettering that names it Smotts' Revenge. To catch the attention of Negolash during the hunt against him, the boat must be turned into bait, heaped with ten barbecued buzzard wings and five bottles of junglevine wine.
